title: Key of love, 500 CFA francs

descriptionPlain: Description Amulet carrying joy and harmony Symbol of love, understanding, and unity Exquisite numismatic embellishments The finest silver Wandering through the labyrinth of life, we uncover the secrets of love, whose essence unfolds with each experience.
